name: How long does a typical sliding door threshold replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door threshold replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door threshold replacement can vary depending on the complexity of the job, the type of door, and the extent of any underlying damage. Generally, a straightforward replacement can take a few hours to a full day. More complex projects involving frame repair or significant adjustments might extend to two days. A professional contractor can provide a more accurate timeline after an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical replacement can take from a few hours to a full day, depending on complexity and any additional repairs needed.
